analysis:
Examined EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift (base and head) and LaunchAgent.swift (patch plus base). The change adds a prefill geometry resolver: DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS env keys, a wide 2048-token default chunk for GPT-OSS, dense Qwen3.5 and Gemma4, and a step budget defaulting to twice the chunk. It also adds a bidirectional-media chunk ceiling. The two new keys are forwarded through the launchd plist allowlist (LaunchAgent.swift lines 286-289). No consumer-controlled input reaches these values. They come from the operator's environment, and the operator is already an in-scope adversary (ADV-001) who controls the provider process, so there is no new privilege boundary.

Security-relevant checks:
- The Nemotron calibrated-limit clamp (head lines 161-168) still runs after geometry resolution and is not widened by the env overrides. Chunk size is clamped with min, the solo stripe is nil, and the mixed cap is clamped.
- The GLM serving scheduler (glm5NextServingScheduler) overrides chunk and step values independently of the new env keys, so its hard bounds hold.
- Malformed, zero or negative values fall back to SDK defaults. Overflow is handled in the doubling via multipliedReportingOverflow.
- The allowlist adds only the two geometry keys. Secrets and diagnostic flags are not forwarded, and the worker opt-in handling is unchanged.

The change has a possible availability and memory effect (T-010/T-029 class): larger prefill chunks raise activation memory, and the comment itself notes MoE Qwen would rise about 2 GiB, which is why MoE is excluded. Exclusion of Nemotron, Bonsai and MoE Qwen from the wide path is deliberate. A larger chunk could change timing side channels relative to the TTFT oracle (T-041/SEC-035), but cache salt scoping, SSD cache crypto and TTL are untouched, so no mitigation is invalidated. Unverified contracts: how the paged pool is sized from PrefillGeometry downstream, and whether step budgets respect the KV and memory admission checks. Those files were not supplied, so I record the gap rather than a finding.
